_comment: Differences that already existed before the editor refactor started.
They are reported separately and do not fail the audit, so that a NEW
difference introduced by the refactor is never buried in old noise.
Every entry is a real finding and gets closed as its section is rebuilt.
Nothing goes in here to make the audit quiet.

missing_in_editor.venus_pv_charge: Read from config.entities by the renderer to size the solar-to-Venus flow (power-flux-card.js ~2595). Missing from BOTH the editor and the entityKeys array, so it is only reachable by hand-editing YAML. Close when the Venus section is rebuilt.
missing_in_editor.show_label_house: Every other source bubble has a label toggle; the house bubble's is read but never offered. Close when the house section is rebuilt.
missing_in_editor.animation_threshold: Global fallback threshold (default 1). Only the per-consumer variant is offered. Close with the global settings section.
missing_in_editor.show_flow_rates: Global flow-rate toggle. Only the per-bubble variants are offered. Close with the global settings section.

surplus_in_editor.venus_charge: Offered as a sensor picker, but the renderer only names it in the top-level-to-entities migration list -- no code path displays it. Either wire it up or drop the control; do not leave it looking functional.
